items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: But Ivory Joe had this thing equipped, man, so the boys didn't have the -- when they stayed overnight somewhere, they stayed in the bus, you know.

ctx.x: Well, that's what I was wondering, if --

It was Specially equipped -- the Newark Charter Company -- and it had 32 seats in it. It was just one of those straight up type seats. They go back, you know, you can lean back, but you're still in a seat. But Ivory Joe had this thing equipped, man, so the boys didn't have the -- when they stayed overnight somewhere, they stayed in the bus, you know.
Yeah. I know a couple of the bands I played on in the '50's, we had buses that way, that were specially built. You had record players and the whole thing.

items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I was just reading about a guy that passed here recently. You remember the guy that wrote a lot of tunes called Ivory Joe Hunter?

ctx.x: But, of course, we didn't have the title. That's it. This brings up a good question, a good statement, rather. I was just reading about a guy that passed here recently. You remember the guy that wrote a lot of tunes called Ivory Joe Hunter?
